business_problem: AtlasV needed stronger AI image and video generation capabilities so its Collart platform could turn static fashion, portrait, and e-commerce assets into scalable commercial content without the time and cost of manual studio production.
solution_summary: AtlasV integrated Alibaba Cloud's Wan 2.7 model family into Collart, its AI visual-creation platform for fashion, e-commerce, portrait, and social content. Users upload model images, clothing images, product photos, or full outfits and optionally supply a reference video that defines movement, camera rhythm, and atmosphere. Wan 2.7 then powers image-to-video generation for walking, turning, product showcases, outfit transitions, and camera push-ins, while the same model family also handles image-to-image generation, portrait restyling, background replacement, multi-shot video generation, audio-visual synchronization, and video editing. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio provides the integration surface that lets AtlasV plug those capabilities into user-facing workflows at scale. The architecture effectively converts static creative assets into production-ready visual sequences faster and with less manual overhead, allowing Collart to support brands, merchants, and creators that need repeatable visual production across campaigns and product catalogs.
business_outcome: AtlasV expanded Collart from static image generation into scalable, commercially usable fashion and portrait video creation workflows.
